question: How can an organization provide live captions?
description: An organization can give deaf and hard of hearing people live captions on their own phone with Captio AI for Organizations.
Captio AI was made for deaf and hard of hearing people and runs on each person's own iPhone or Android phone, for in-person speech.
Captio AI for Organizations has one yearly license per person, paid by invoice, with no minimum, no setup fee and no automatic renewal.
Captio AI for Organizations costs USD 109 per person per year for 1 to 19 people and USD 89 from 20 people, excluding VAT where it applies.
Captio AI for Organizations offers a free 30-day pilot for up to 5 people, with nothing to pay and nothing to sign.
Each person in a pilot opens a forwarded link, continues with Apple or Google and gets Captio AI on iPhone or Android.
An organization using Captio AI sees usage totals only, never what was said.
Accounts and saved transcripts from Captio AI are stored in the European Union, and audio is not kept on Captio AI's servers.
Captio AI does not replace a human captioner where a perfect record is required.
